posts.title: The true forms, rebuilt
posts.body: Every Unchained boss in Prismfall · Test is now a boss of its own: a new body, new attacks and a second phase. The Hive Empress returns as a vast wasp sovereign with a venom lance, the Mirror Colossus becomes a faceted monolith that reflects your own ship, and the Rift Titan is the apex of every shape, its great eye split by the Rift.

posts.title: Bigger chapters, and something unreleased
posts.body: Every story chapter now runs four or five objectives across a bigger, more detailed map: escort the evacuation bus through Landfall, carry seed cores out of the Cold Vault, smash the Hive Empress’s printing vats, hunt a fleeing Prime Splinter. Data logs hide the rest of the story. Type a certain word on the main menu and the Chronicle I bosses come back unchained.

posts.title: LUMEN is coming
posts.body: Our next game is a lane-siege strategy game set in a ruined observatory: three lanes, two Lenses, and reinforcements you have to time. It is not out yet. Press Notify me on its page to hear the day it releases.

posts.title: Spectra IDE 1.0
posts.body: The code editor we build Spectra with is now yours too: a small, fast native editor with tabs, a split view, a terminal, find and replace, a command palette and plugins for Python, Lua, web, Gradle, Minecraft and Terraria modding. Free for Windows.

posts.title: Launcher 0.6.4: screenshots on game pages
posts.body: Game pages in the launcher and on the website now show real screenshots. Spectra for Android 0.1.4 has them too.

posts.title: The Library of Light becomes a library
posts.body: The Spiral Oracle’s chapter is now a round archive around the Halo well: bookcases full of spines, reading tables with lamps, marble columns, globes, chandeliers and tomes floating over the well.

posts.title: A story you play through
posts.body: Story chapters became runs of objectives with their own scenery and lines of lore, bosses arrive through gates, and three interludes fill the gap between Chronicle I and II. The Rainbow became the strongest and hardest secret class.

posts.title: Prismfall 1.4 ALPHA
posts.body: Lore told as you play, the end of Chronicle II, melee weapons for the Reaper, the Iron Sovereign rework, a Level Creator in beta, and a shop that makes new trails every week.
